definition.def: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.
examples: He has failed to work out a coherent strategy for modernising the service.
The President's policy is perfectly coherent.

definition.def: If someone is coherent, they express their thoughts in a clear and calm way, so that other people can understand what they are saying.
examples: He's so calm when he answers questions in interviews. I wish I could be that coherent.

definition.def: Coherence is a state or situation in which all the parts or ideas fit together well so that they form a united whole.
examples: The anthology has a surprising sense of coherence.
